extracted.intended_audience: AP Calculus AB educators and students (educators authorized to teach the course)
extracted.subtask_description: A College Board resource page listing downloadable AP Calculus AB free-response questions (FRQs) and associated materials (scoring guidelines, sample responses, chief reader reports, and scoring statistics) for recent exam years. It directs educators to AP Classroom for additional archived practice materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free-Response Questions (FRQs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Download free-response questions from exams from the past three years. Educators authorized to teach this course can always access comprehensive and secure practice questions in AP Classroom from years prior to those listed on AP Central.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides links to the most recent released FRQs as downloadable PDFs; additional, older practice questions are available through AP Classroom for authorized educators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scoring Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Scoring guidelines are provided alongside the free-response questions for each listed year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These linked scoring-guideline PDFs serve as the official rubric used to evaluate students' FRQ responses and are available for download from the year-specific sections (e.g., 2025, 2024, 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample Responses and Commentary (Sample Responses Q1–Q6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sample responses from exam takers for each free-response question (Q1–Q6) are provided, organized by question.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sample responses and accompanying commentary illustrate examples of student work and how the scoring guidelines are applied to award points at different score levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chief Reader Report
rubrics_metrics.description: The Chief Reader Report for each exam year is listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Chief Reader Report (available for each year on the page) summarizes scoring trends, common student errors, and reader guidance from that year's exam administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scoring Statistics and Scoring/ Subscore Distributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Scoring statistics and distributions (including subscore distributions where provided) are available for each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These documents provide aggregate data on how students scored on the exam and individual questions, useful for contextualizing scoring and difficulty across cohorts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility / Assistive Technology Support
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are using assistive technology and need help accessing these PDFs in another format, contact Services for Students with Disabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides contact phone and email (212-713-8333; [email protected]) for accommodations or alternate-format materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educator Authorization for Additional Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Educators authorized to teach the course have access to comprehensive and secure practice questions in AP Classroom beyond the years listed on AP Central.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural/access criterion: some archived or additional practice materials require AP Classroom authorization and are not directly downloadable from the AP Central public page.
